items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Bessie Smith, that was her last engagement before she went South and got in the automobile accident. ... So in other words, when you backed her that time...

ctx.x: Would you say -- you know, you mentioned Louis, would you say that Louis was very important in drawing you into the music?

Louis, Bessie Smith, the local radio shops used to pipe the music out into the street and you'd hear these blues. Well, blues was a no-no in a middle class black family. That was sinful music. But it appealed to me.
Just to backtrack a little, were any of the musicians who you rehearsed with in that band, did any of them go on to play professionally, make any kind of a mark?
